title: 오르골 광장
description: 장난감 왕국의 거대한 오르골이 연주를 시작한 축제 광장에서 춤추는 인형과 악단 사이 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아냅니다.
theme: 장난감 왕국 대모험 — 오르골 광장의 정오 연주회
scene: A festive toy-sized town square in the same handcrafted toy kingdom, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle like a premium tabletop diorama. A grand open wooden music box occupies the center, its cream lid raised behind a circular stage and one oversized antique-gold five-point star topper clearly isolated at upper center. On the stage, one graceful wooden ballerina turns in a sunflower-yellow bodice and one large coral-red stitched-felt skirt, fully visible. At lower left, the recurring small wooden soldier in a cobalt-blue cloth cape conducts a tiny toy orchestra; beside him stands one chunky painted-tin elephant musician whose single nearest oversized ear is vivid turquoise. At upper right, exactly three large polished brass bells hang in one straight horizontal row from the pale canopy, clearly separated with empty space between them. At lower right, a friendly plush rabbit musician stands behind one large cream toy drum whose front face bears one simple vivid-turquoise diamond emblem. Add wooden peg-doll musicians, blank sheet-music cards, a small xylophone, round stools, felt flowers, ribbon bunting, and scattered star confetti only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the gold star topper, coral skirt, turquoise elephant ear, three hanging bells, and turquoise drum emblem large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, logos, or clock numerals.
